keymapAction.description: Confirmed against https://docs.atuin.sh/latest/configuration/advanced-key-binding/. accept-N and return-selection-N (N=1-9) are matched via pattern rather than enumerated.

when.description: Condition expression built from atoms (cursor-at-start, cursor-at-end, input-empty, original-input-empty, list-at-start, list-at-end, no-results, has-results, has-context), combinable with &&, ||, !, and parentheses.

keymapTable.description: Maps a key name (e.g. "up", "ctrl-r") to an action, or to an ordered list of conditional rules.

logComponent.description: Per-component log settings. Source: LogConfig in crates/atuin-client/src/settings.rs.

enabled.description: Override the global `logs.enabled` for this log.

file.description: Log file name (relative to `logs.dir`) or an absolute path.

level.description: Override the global `logs.level` for this log.

retention.description: Override the global `logs.retention` for this log: a duration like "7d", or a bare number of days.

description: Unofficial schema for Atuin's client config.toml — Atuin does not publish one upstream (see atuinsh/atuin#2161). Derived from https://docs.atuin.sh/latest/configuration/config/, `atuin default-config`, and crates/atuin-client/src/settings.rs (the actual Settings struct), so it covers fields the printed default-config template omits (keymap, sync_protocol, search score multipliers, logs, ai.capabilities, etc). dotfiles/scripts/kv/meta are left permissive — their exact nested shape wasn't confirmed from source.

api_token.description: Bearer token sent to a self-hosted AI server. Must exactly match that server's own AUTH_TOKEN configuration — set AUTH_TOKEN on the server process, then set this to the same value on the client.

capabilities.description: Which tools the AI assistant is allowed to use.

enable_command_execution.description: Allow the assistant to execute shell commands directly.

enable_file_tools.description: Allow the assistant to read/write files.

enable_history_output.description: Allow the assistant to view captured output of previous commands (requires pty_proxy + daemon).

enable_history_search.description: Allow the assistant to search your Atuin history.

db_path.description: Where to store the AI assistant's own session database. Defaults under data_dir.

enabled.description: Enable the Atuin AI assistant (bound to `?` on an empty prompt).

endpoint.description: Base URL of a self-hosted atuin-ai-server instance (any OpenAI-compatible backend) to use instead of Atuin Hub.

endpoint_protocol.description: Which protocol to speak to the configured AI endpoint: Atuin Hub's, the open-source atuin-ai-server's, or auto-detect.

model.description: Model alias/name to request from the configured endpoint.

opening.description: What context is automatically sent to the AI assistant when it opens.

send_cwd.description: Include the current working directory as context.

send_last_command.description: Include the last-run command as context.

send_cwd.description: Deprecated top-level flag for including the working directory in AI requests — superseded by ai.opening.send_cwd.

session_continue_minutes.description: How long an AI chat session can be idle before a new `?` invocation starts a fresh session instead of continuing the previous one.

yolo.description: Skip the AI assistant's own permission/safety checks (e.g. the double-Enter confirmation on commands it flags as dangerous).

auto_hide_height.description: In compact style only: auto-hide the tabs row when fewer than this many lines are available. 0 never auto-hides.

command_chaining.description: When triggered after &&, || or |, complete commands to chain rather than replace the current line.

ctrl_n_shortcuts.description: Use Ctrl instead of Alt as the modifier for numerical UI shortcuts (alt-0..alt-9).

cwd_filter.description: Unanchored regexes; commands run with a matching cwd are never written to history.

autostart.description: Automatically start and manage the daemon when needed. Not compatible with systemd_socket = true.

enabled.description: Enable using the daemon to sync.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the daemon pidfile. Defaults to <data_dir>/atuin-daemon.pid.

socket_path.description: Path to the unix socket used by the daemon (unix systems only). Defaults to <data_dir>/atuin.sock.

sync_frequency.description: How often the daemon should sync, in seconds.

systemd_socket.description: Use systemd socket activation rather than opening socket_path directly (linux only).

tcp_port.description: TCP port used for daemon communication on non-unix systems.

data_dir.description: Base directory for Atuin data files (databases, keys, session, etc). Defaults to the system data directory (~/.local/share/atuin on linux/mac).

db_path.description: Where to store the history database. Defaults to <data_dir>/history.db.

dialect.description: Date format used when displaying history.

dotfiles.description: Dotfiles-sync (aliases/env vars) configuration. Exact nested shape not confirmed from source; treat as best-effort/permissive.

enter_accept.description: If true, Enter immediately executes the selected command and Tab places it in the prompt for editing. If false, both Enter and Tab just populate the prompt.

exit_mode.description: What to do with the command line when Escape is pressed while searching.

extra_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent on every request to the sync server, e.g. for a proxy requiring its own auth header. Headers Atuin sets itself (e.g. Authorization) cannot be overridden, and cross-origin redirects are refused once set.

filter_mode.description: Filter mode used for interactive search. "global" is the least restrictive: it shows history from every host/session/directory, not a special keyword beyond being the broadest enum value.

filter_mode_shell_up_key_binding.description: Filter mode used when Atuin is invoked from the shell's up-key binding. Defaults to filter_mode when unset.

history_filter.description: Unanchored regexes; commands matching any of these are never written to history.

history_format.description: Default history list format, can also be set with the --format CLI arg.

inline_height.description: Maximum number of lines the inline interface should take up. 0 means always fullscreen.

inline_height_shell_up_key_binding.description: Same as inline_height, but when invoked from the shell's up-key binding.

invert.description: Put the search bar at the top of the UI instead of the bottom.

key_path.description: Where to store the E2E-encryption key used for sync. Defaults to <data_dir>/key.

keymap.description: Custom keybindings for the TUI, added in v18.12.0. One table per keymap mode (section names not fully confirmed from source — seen written as [keymap.emacs]/[keymap.vim-normal]/[keymap.vim-insert]/[keymap.inspector]/[keymap.prefix] in one source, so left permissive here rather than a fixed enum). Each entry maps a key name to either a single action string, or an ordered list of {when, action} conditional rules (first match wins; unbound keys pass through). See https://docs.atuin.sh/latest/configuration/advanced-key-binding/ for the authoritative action/condition names.

keymap_cursor.description: Cursor style per keymap mode. Values are "default" or "{blink,steady}-{block,underline,bar}".

keymap_mode.description: Startup keymap for `atuin search`. "auto" picks based on the shell's keymap where the keybinding is defined.

keymap_mode_shell.description: Same as keymap_mode, but specifically for shell-initiated (up-arrow) invocations.

keys.description: Keybinding edge-case behavior in the interactive search UI.

accept_past_line_end.description: Right arrow behaves like Tab: copies the selected line to the command line for editing.

accept_past_line_start.description: Left arrow behaves like Tab: copies the selected line to the command line for editing.

accept_with_backspace.description: Backspace at the start of the line behaves like Tab: copies the selected line to the command line for editing.

exit_past_line_start.description: Left arrow exits the TUI when scrolling before the first character.

prefix.description: The key that activates "prefix" keymap mode (a leader-key style modal layer), used together with the [keymap.prefix] table.

scroll_exits.description: Up/down exits the TUI when scrolled past the first/last entry.

kv.description: Key-value store configuration. Exact nested shape not confirmed from source; treat as best-effort/permissive.

local_timeout.description: Timeout, in seconds, for acquiring a local sqlite database connection.

ai.description: Log overrides for the AI assistant.

dir.description: Directory log files are written to.

retention.description: How long to keep log files: a duration like "12h" or "7d", or a bare number of days. 0 keeps nothing.

search.description: Log overrides for interactive search (only used with `--interactive`).

max_preview_height.description: Maximum height of the command preview pane.

meta.description: Metadata store configuration. Exact nested shape not confirmed from source; treat as best-effort/permissive.

no_mouse.description: Disable mouse input handling in the interactive UI.

output.description: Command output capture (Atuin 18.22+). Needs `[daemon]` and `[pty_proxy]` enabled; `atuin config enable output-capture` sets all three up. Source: crates/atuin-client/src/settings/output.rs, https://docs.atuin.sh/latest/guide/output-capture/.

enabled.description: Capture and store the output of the commands you run. When false, the other keys are ignored. Enabling takes a daemon restart and a new shell.

max_disk_usage.description: The most disk space captured output may use: "unlimited", a percentage of the disk holding the data directory ("10%"), a size ("10GB"), or a number of bytes. Past the limit the daemon deletes the oldest output first. Restart the daemon after changing it.

max_output_size.description: The most output kept for one command; past it Atuin keeps the start and end and drops the middle. A size like "512KB" or "2MB", or a number of bytes. Read when the shell starts.

sync.description: Reserved for syncing captured output between machines. Not implemented: captured output never leaves the machine, whatever this is set to.

prefers_reduced_motion.description: Minimize UI motion (e.g. timers won't update live). Can also be set via the NO_MOTION env var.

strategy.description: How to calculate the preview height (respects max_preview_height). auto: length of the selected command. static: length of the longest command in history. fixed: always use max_preview_height.

pty_proxy.description: PTY proxy configuration. Normally Atuin only sees what you typed (via shell hooks). Enabling this re-execs your shell inside `atuin pty-proxy`, a pseudo-terminal wrapper that also captures everything printed to the screen (command output), enabling features like reviewing/searching past command output, not just command text.

enabled.description: If enabled, `atuin init` first re-execs your shell inside `atuin pty-proxy`, so a separate `eval "$(atuin pty-proxy init)"` line isn't needed. Supported for bash, zsh, fish and nu on unix.

record_store_path.description: Where to store the generic record store database (backs sync records, dotfiles, scripts, kv, etc), separate from the history DB. Defaults to <data_dir>/records.db.

scripts.description: Saved-scripts database configuration. Exact nested shape not confirmed from source; treat as best-effort/permissive.

scroll_context_lines.description: Number of context lines shown when scrolling by pages.

search.description: Interactive search filter and ranking configuration.

filters.description: Enabled filter modes, in priority order. "workspace" is skipped when not in a workspace or workspaces = false.

frecency_score_multiplier.description: Weight given to the combined recency+frequency ("frecency") score, when smart_sort ranks results.

frequency_score_multiplier.description: Weight given to how often a command has been run, when smart_sort ranks results.

recency_score_multiplier.description: Weight given to how recently a command was run, when smart_sort ranks results.

shells.description: Filter results by the shell that ran the command. "all": show everything. "auto": only the current shell type (plus entries with no recorded shell). Array: an explicit allow-list of shell names (include "" to allow entries with no recorded shell).

search_mode.description: Search mode used for interactive search.

search_mode_shell_up_key_binding.description: Search mode used when Atuin is invoked from the shell's up-key binding. Defaults to the value of search_mode when unset.

secrets_filter.description: Match history against a default regex set (AWS key IDs, GitHub PATs, Slack OAuth/webhook tokens, Stripe keys) and skip saving matches.

session_path.description: Where to store the cached sync-server auth session token. Defaults to <data_dir>/session.

shell_up_key_binding.description: Whether Atuin takes over the shell's up-arrow binding at all.

show_help.description: Show the help row (Atuin version, update availability, keymap hint, total command count).

show_numeric_shortcuts.description: Show numeric shortcuts (1..9) beside list items in the TUI.

show_preview.description: Show a preview pane with the full text of the currently-selected history entry — useful when the command is longer than the terminal width, or is a multi-line script, and would otherwise be cut off.

show_tabs.description: Show tabs for Search and Inspect.

smart_sort.description: Enable smarter result ranking beyond plain recency/frequency (see search.*_score_multiplier for tuning the weights it uses).

stats.description: Configuration for `atuin stats`, which reports things like your most-used commands and estimated time saved. These settings control counting granularity, not history recording.

common_prefix.description: Commands stripped/ignored as a prefix before counting stats, e.g. "sudo" so `sudo apt` counts as `apt`.

common_subcommands.description: Commands whose subcommand should be counted separately in stats, e.g. with "git" listed here, `git commit` and `git log` are tracked as distinct entries instead of both collapsing into one "git" count.

ignored_commands.description: Commands completely excluded from stats, e.g. "cd", "ls", "vi".

store_failed.description: Store commands that failed (non-zero exit status).

strip_trailing_whitespace.description: Strip trailing spaces/tabs from commands before saving to history. Escaped trailing whitespace is preserved.

style.description: Display style to use for the interactive UI.

sync_frequency.description: How often to sync history. Only triggered when a command runs, so intervals may be longer in practice. "0" syncs after every command.

sync_protocol.description: Which sync/auth protocol to speak to the sync server: Atuin Hub's, the legacy self-hosted protocol, or auto-detect.

debug.description: Whether the theme manager outputs extra debug information to help fix themes.

max_depth.description: Maximum theme-inheritance resolution depth, when a theme extends another theme.

name.description: Theme name: built-in "default"/"autumn"/"marine", or the filename stem of a custom TOML theme under the config dir's themes/ subdirectory (or ATUIN_THEME_DIR).

timezone.description: Timezone for displaying timestamps: "l"/"local" for system local time, or a UTC offset like "+9", "-05", "+03:30".

tmux.description: tmux popup integration (requires tmux >= 3.2; zsh/bash/fish only, and not compatible with iTerm2's native tmux integration).

enabled.description: Use a tmux popup window for interactive search when running inside tmux. Can also be controlled via the ATUIN_TMUX_POPUP env var.

height.description: Height of the tmux popup window: a percentage string or an integer line count.

width.description: Width of the tmux popup window: a percentage string or an integer character count.

columns.description: Columns shown left-to-right in interactive search (the selection indicator is always shown first, implicitly).

expand.description: Makes the column fill remaining space. Defaults to true for "command", false otherwise. Only one column should have expand = true.

syntax_highlight.description: Syntax-highlight commands in search results using the active theme's colors. Not available on all platforms (e.g. Windows).

update_channel.description: Release channel followed by `atuin update` and update checks.

update_check.description: Enable or disable automatic update checks.

word_chars.description: Characters that count as part of a word for word-jump purposes.

word_jump_mode.description: Word-boundary jump semantics used for word-wise cursor movement.

workspaces.description: When enabled, use workspace filtering by default (filters for commands executed anywhere within the current git repository tree) when available.

title: Atuin config.toml
